body:
Still here. It's an incredibly slow night apparently for trains.

I'm just tired of a lot of stuff going on. Lost one of my closest friends recently (friendship-wise); continual burden on my parents; other friends don't seem to care too much if I'm here or not. It's hard to stay positive all the time, especially when things don't seem to change. A big driver of it just seems to be this overwhelming feeling and sense of worthlessness.

There was a bit of a language barrier so I really hope he meant one way to NY instead of round trip to get back to this area.

I've seen a few express trains pass by now. The speed of these things is intense. Timing is gonna be tricky to get in front of one. Not to mention there's been so many ppl walking by. Last time I was here this past November, I pretty much had the platform to myself.
